description: Performance totals for an ad account over a date window. Accepts friendly lowercase metric names (e.g. impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc, conversion_page_visit_clicks) validated locally before the call. Money metrics come back in USD. Defaults to the last 7 days. Use get_daily_performance for a per-day breakdown, compare_periods for change against the prior window, or compare_ads to rank the ads inside one ad group.

account_id.description: Ad account id. Falls back to REDDIT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID.

breakdowns.description: Dimensions to break down by, e.g. date, campaign_id, country, community.

metrics.description: Friendly metric names. Default: a useful spend+conversions set.

name: get_performance_report
